about: How each member voted on each recorded vote of the current Congress, from the official roll call records. Y yea, N nay, P present, X not voting, O voted for a named person, - not in the roll. Not voting is not a no. A vote is on one question, and a yea on a rule or a motion is not a yea on the bill. No scores, no rankings, no percentages.
